--add-gitignore-files.reason: Aider appends every gitignored path to .aiderignore at startup; the maintainer reads .aiderignore but does not generate it from gitignore (aider/args.py:154-158, aider/main.py:398-402).

--alias.reason: Pi model aliases live in models.json

--analytics.reason: Aider's analytics collection; pi-maintainer sends no telemetry.

--analytics-disable.reason: Aider's analytics collection; pi-maintainer sends no telemetry.

--analytics-log.reason: Aider's analytics collection; pi-maintainer sends no telemetry.

--analytics-posthog-host.reason: Aider's analytics collection; pi-maintainer sends no telemetry.

--analytics-posthog-project-api-key.reason: Aider's analytics collection; pi-maintainer sends no telemetry.

--apply-clipboard-edits.reason: Aider applies edits from the clipboard; Pi exposes no clipboard API to extensions (aider/args.py:147-151).

--cache-prompts.reason: Pi owns prompt cache retention and cache warming

--chat-history-file.reason: Pi session storage owns chat history files

--check-update.reason: Aider updates its own installation; Pi manages its own releases.

--commit.reason: Aider commits dirty files and exits after the one-shot message; the maintainer commits each edit turn and /commit covers manual commits. Ending the process from a turn hook is a Pi session-lifecycle difference recorded in docs/NATIVE-GAPS.md.

--detect-urls.reason: Aider offers to open URLs found in model output; Pi exposes no URL-open API to extensions (aider/args.py:330-336).

--disable-playwright.reason: Aider's Playwright web scraping; outside the four ported features.

--exit.reason: Pi runs one-shot prompts with --print or --no-session

--gui.reason: Aider's Streamlit browser GUI; Pi provides its own terminal interface.

--install-main-branch.reason: Aider updates its own installation; Pi manages its own releases.

--just-check-update.reason: Aider updates its own installation; Pi manages its own releases.

--llm-history-file.reason: Pi session storage contains the provider transcript

--load.reason: Pi loads its own resource files and offers no extension command-script loader

--message.reason: Pi takes the prompt as a positional argument

--model.reason: Pi selects the session model and the maintainer reads it from ctx.modelRegistry

--model-metadata-file.reason: Pi owns the model catalog and modelOverrides

--model-settings-file.reason: Pi owns model settings in models.json

--openai-api-base.reason: Pi owns provider endpoints in models.json

--openai-api-deployment-id.reason: Pi owns provider protocols in models.json

--openai-api-type.reason: Pi owns provider protocols in models.json

--openai-api-version.reason: Pi owns provider protocols in models.json

--reasoning-effort.reason: Pi owns thinking levels per model

--restore-chat-history.reason: Pi owns history restore through sessions

--show-diffs.reason: Pi renders transcript diffs itself and exposes no extension surface for them

--show-prompts.reason: Aider prints its system prompt and examples then exits; the maintainer builds prompts through PromptSource and Pi owns process exit (aider/args.py:341-346, aider/main.py:1050-1060).

--show-release-notes.reason: Aider updates its own installation; Pi manages its own releases.

--skip-sanity-check-repo.reason: Aider can skip its repository sanity checks; the maintainer always runs sanityCheckRepo so a corrupt or bare repository degrades to no Git instead of being trusted (aider/args.py:264-269, aider/main.py:700-710).

--stream.reason: Pi streams every provider response through its model runtime

--thinking-tokens.reason: Pi owns thinking budgets per model

--upgrade.reason: Aider updates its own installation; Pi manages its own releases.

--verify-ssl.reason: Pi owns provider transport TLS settings

--version.reason: Pi reports its own version with pi --version

--voice-format.reason: Aider transcribes voice input in its app shell; Pi has no voice input.

--voice-input-device.reason: Aider transcribes voice input in its app shell; Pi has no voice input.

--voice-language.reason: Aider transcribes voice input in its app shell; Pi has no voice input.

--watch-files.reason: Aider watches files for AI comments; the watch host attachment is a documented native gap in docs/NATIVE-GAPS.md (aider/args.py:166-170).
